ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with black pigmentation dominating the lateral margins and white clusters concentrated centrally and on the left lobe distal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white patch on the distal-left lobe; significant white mottling/speckling along the central peduncle axis; large contiguous black regions on the proximal lobes and terminal ends.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 52 degrees and a depth of approximately 140 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across both lobes; major jagged indentation on the distal-right trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations varies between 5-15 pixels from the mean linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering into sharp, irregular terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular white clusters (approx. 5-12 pixels in diameter) scattered across the right lobe and central fluke area, suggesting localized pigment disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (20-150 pixels) criss-crossing both lobes, predominantly oriented horizontally and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular calcification-like textures on both fluke tips; significant notch or loss of tissue on the upper-right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine high-intensity white pixel spray at the base of the fluke where the peduncle meets the water line, creating a temporary contrast boundary.
